page.overview:
Who is Pashtarot?

Pashtarot is a character from Final Fantasy XIV. He is one of the Ascians introduced during the A Realm Reborn epilogue, praising Zodiark alongside his fellow Ascians, but he has not appeared since. With the conclusion of Hydaelyn–Zodiark arc in Endwalker, Pashtarot is one of the Ascians whose current whereabouts are unknown.

In Amaurot's Convocation of Fourteen, the position of Pashtarot was given to the preserver of discipline and order. Pashtarot was mentioned in passing by Emet-Selch upon learning of the potential dangers of Kairos, a memory reconfiguration system used in Elpis.

Pashtarot wears the standard Ascian uniform, black leather hooded coat with purple markings and adornments. He appears without his hood and mask, revealing that his vessel has spiky blond hair.

"Pashtarot" refers to the Scion of Light "Pashtarot, Knight-Star" referred to in the profile of Zeromus from Final Fantasy XII.
